changelog: The update's "Compatible up to" names the WordPress you run when it is a later point release of the version the plugin was tested on. Before, a plugin tested on 7.1 showed "This plugin has not been tested with your current version of WordPress" in View details on 7.1.4, and Dashboard → Updates said its compatibility was unknown. A newer WordPress, such as 7.2, still shows the warning.
Changelog lines in View details show exactly as written. Before, a line that spelled out an HTML character code, such as the code for an apostrophe, showed the character instead of the text typed.
